decisive_items: alveoli filled with inflammatory debris consisting of granulation tissue, interstitial inflammation, and areas of intra-alveolar fibrin deposition
Repeat BAL was negative for AFB, fungus, and Pneumocystis jirovecii
response.rationale: Initial PJP was treated and resolved; new infiltrates with negative BAL and biopsy showing granulation tissue and intra-alveolar fibrin are classic for organizing pneumonia, not recurrent infection or drug pneumonitis.

rejected.why: Initial PJP resolved; repeat BAL negative for PJP.
Idiopathic pneumonia syndrome is a post-transplant noninfectious diffuse lung injury, but biopsy findings favor organizing pneumonia.
Tacrolimus pneumonitis is rare and not supported by biopsy pattern.
No fungal evidence; BAL negative for fungus.
Interstitial lung disease is nonspecific; biopsy indicates organizing pneumonia.
CMV excluded by negative BAL inclusion bodies.
Mycophenolate pneumonitis possible but biopsy pattern and clinical course favor organizing pneumonia.
